verdict.rationale: SerpApi is a search-results API, and the evidence shows no in-product feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from the user's own data. The AI-related items are adjacent: scraping third-party AI answers (Google AI Mode, AI Overview, Shopping AI recommendations), LLM-optimized markdown output, and an MCP server that lets external agents call SerpApi. None of these is SerpApi itself producing insights inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
